clauses.reason: A source-journal-only edit can be proved not to change test inputs without a repository provider, while current admission still runs.

updates.rationale: Journal-only reuse removes duplicate testing without guessing source impacts or weakening source approval, failure accounting and input identity.
updates.statement: Structured repository selection is optional. Changed explains without checks. Without a provider, readiness selects the complete member-safe gate; only a proved journal-only suffix may reuse successful matching test evidence after current admission. Other paths require a provider for narrowing or inheritance. Final always executes its complete declared gate.

clauses.reason: Invalid source authority and open observations must be rejected when first eligible, not only at final.

updates.rationale: The same invalid source cannot become acceptable merely because a different lifecycle operation reads it.
updates.statement: One current-source verdict checks approved package authority, journal ancestry and unresolved observations at ready, admission, continuation and final before checks. Gate-specific selected-shard resolution supplies the same owed-node accounting. Neither inherited tests nor covers declarations waive source admission. Staged conflict resolutions are judged before commit.

clauses.reason: Declared coverage alone cannot establish semantic compatibility of the merged source.

updates.rationale: Actually testing the merged increment detects cross-member semantic breakage when it enters a batch, rather than at final.
updates.statement: Diagnostics, readiness and CI share supervised execution and allocation. Admission and continuation prepare the exact merged increment since the last passing batch tip and execute its selected member test validation as well as declared batch checks. Declared covers alone cannot substitute for selected test execution. Without a provider the full member-safe gate is selected. Final remains complete.
